items.exampleEn: Our hostess welcomed us with tea and cake.
items.exampleZh: 女主人用茶和蛋糕招待我們。

items.exampleEn: There is a warm rapport between the two singers on stage.
items.exampleZh: 台上兩位歌手之間有一種溫暖的默契。

items.exampleEn: In the old story, the princess had many suitors.
items.exampleZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，公主有許多追求者。

items.exampleEn: My paternal grandparents live in the countryside.
items.exampleZh: 我的爺爺奶奶住在鄉下。
items.glossZh: 父親的、父系的；父親般的

items.exampleEn: "Gypsy" is an older word; many people now say "Roma" instead.
items.exampleZh: Gypsy（吉普賽人）是較舊的說法，現在很多人改說 Roma。
items.glossZh: 吉普賽人（舊稱，具冒犯意味）

items.exampleEn: The old school rules were paternalistic and strict.
items.exampleZh: 舊的校規是家長式的，而且很嚴格。
items.glossZh: 家長式作風的；管太多的

items.exampleEn: She is the possessor of a rare talent for languages.
items.exampleZh: 她擁有罕見的語言天分。

items.exampleEn: The head teacher had a warm, maternalistic way with new students.
items.exampleZh: 校長對新生溫暖親切，像母親一樣照顧他們。

items.sentenceEn: The hostess welcomed each guest at the door with a smile.
items.sentenceZh: 女主人在門口微笑著迎接每一位客人。

items.audioEn: As the proud possessor of a new camera, Leo took photos all day.
items.audioZh: Leo 得意地擁有了一台新相機，整天都在拍照。

items.sentenceEn: My paternal grandfather was a fisherman all his life.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺（爸爸的父親）一輩子都是漁夫。

items.sentenceEn: The company has attracted a new suitor from Japan.
items.sentenceZh: 這家公司吸引了一位來自日本、有意收購的新買家。

items.stemEn: Some staff dislike the manager's ____ style; he makes every decision for them.
items.stemZh: 有些員工不喜歡經理家長式的作風；他什麼決定都替他們做。

items.stemEn: After the dinner party, we thanked our ____ for a wonderful evening.
items.stemZh: 晚宴結束後，我們謝謝女主人讓我們度過美好的夜晚。

items.passageEn: My grandmother is the proud possessor of a box of old letters from her youth. Last week, she gave us a synopsis of each one. In one letter, a young suitor writes about meeting her at a summer dance. She says she built a quick rapport with him because they both loved music. However, her father was very paternalistic and did not allow her to go out alone. Her aunt, who was more maternalistic, often helped her secretly. The letters also mention a group of traveling musicians whom people then called "gypsies"; today, the name Roma is usually preferred.
items.passageZh: 我奶奶珍藏著一盒年輕時的舊信件。上週，她把每封信的大意講給我們聽。其中一封信裡，一位年輕的追求者寫到在一場夏日舞會上認識她。她說，因為兩人都熱愛音樂，所以很快就很投緣。不過，她的父親管得很嚴，不准她單獨出門。她的阿姨比較像媽媽一樣照顧她，常常偷偷幫她。信裡也提到一群四處表演的樂手，當時人們稱他們為「吉普賽人」；現在通常比較傾向使用 Roma 這個名稱。

questions.questionZh: 奶奶為什麼很快就和那位追求者很投緣？

items.promptZh: 他對員工的態度像父親一樣，很照顧大家。
referenceEn: He has a paternal, caring attitude toward his staff.
He treats his employees in a caring, paternal way.
rubricZh: paternal 表示「父親般的」（例如 a paternal attitude、in a paternal way 等）
「照顧大家」可寫，例如 caring、looks after everyone 等

items.instructionZh: 用 rapport 造一個句子，說說你和某個人如何建立融洽的關係。
referenceEn: I built a good rapport with my neighbors by sharing fruit from my garden.
I have a great rapport with my manager because we both love hiking.
rubricZh: rapport 表示「融洽的關係」（例如 built a good rapport with…、have a rapport with… 等）
句子要說到你自己和某個人的關係

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項重複出現且一眼可排除：acre、oval 再次出現，woo 為動詞、oval 為形容詞，與名詞空格詞性不同
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: acre、oval 換成 possessor（本課）、descent（u09-l01），皆為名詞、放得進 thanked our ____ 但語意不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：suitor（有意收購者）譯成「新收購者」不精確，像是已經收購；宜作「一個來自日本、有意收購的新買家」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改譯「這家公司吸引了一位來自日本、有意收購的新買家」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q13 干擾項 uncharacteristic、spacious 跨課重複
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 aesthetic、geological（u08 形容詞），保留 acoustic

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：執行長裁示：gypsy 釋義寫明舊稱、具冒犯意味
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改為「吉普賽人（舊稱，具冒犯意味）」，例句中譯已說明現多用 Roma

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：hostess 例句「The hostess at the restaurant showed us to our table.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「女主人」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「Our hostess welcomed us with tea and cake.」示範第一義；釋義為「女主人；女接待員」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：paternal 例句「He felt a paternal pride when his student won the prize.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「父親的、父系的」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「My paternal grandparents live in the countryside.」示範第一義；釋義為「父親的、父系的；父親般的」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：paternal 表示「父親般的」（例如 a paternal attitude、in a paternal way 等）／「照顧大家」可寫，例如 caring、looks after everyone 等／「員工」可寫，例如 staff、employees 等
